policies.title: AML Client Due-Diligence Policy
policies.body: Purpose and scope. This policy governs client due diligence, transaction monitoring and reporting across all business functions. The Money Laundering Reporting Officer is the responsible owner and shall review this policy annually. Client due-diligence records must be maintained and refreshed at the intervals defined by the supervisor. The institution shall report qualifying transactions to the supervisor within the prescribed period, no later than the statutory deadline, via the regulatory reporting function. Firms must maintain an up-to-date register of beneficial owners. Transaction records must be retained for the statutory retention period and archived securely. Staff must complete annual training every year. Suspicious activity shall be escalated to the compliance function without delay and reported to the authority. Breaches shall be escalated and notified within the required window.
